column2: Get the exact complaint, the mode and the event log before changing anything
If the device failed in clinical use: preserve it and the log, take it out of service, inform the responsible person
Test with known good battery, cable and pads into the analyser
Check configuration: mode at power-on, sync, energy defaults, filters, printing
Use the manufacturer's troubleshooting table for error codes
Escalate HV faults with full information; arrange a replacement unit
Before return: full performance verification, electrical safety, final self-test, clinical settings, in-date battery and pads
Record measured values, instruments, parts, result, next due date and label

column1: Decision: in service / restricted / out of service
